def.short: a person you were once in a relationship with
def.long: A person who was once your boyfriend, girlfriend, husband, or wife, but is not any more. People often say 'my ex' instead of using the name.

examples.en: I saw my ex at the supermarket today.
examples.tr: Bugün markette eski sevgilimi gördüm.

examples.en: She is still friends with her ex.
examples.tr: Eski sevgilisiyle hâlâ arkadaş.

examples.en: His ex lives in another city now.
examples.tr: Eski sevgilisi artık başka bir şehirde yaşıyor.

tr.note: 'Ex' tek başına hem 'eski sevgili' hem 'eski eş' olabilir; bağlama bakılır. Net söylemek için 'ex-husband', 'ex-wife' denir. Günlük konuşma dilidir.

quiz.cloze: I still talk to my ______ because we have a child.

def.short: do something enjoyable because it is a special day or something good happened
def.long: To do something enjoyable, such as having a party or a special meal, because it is a special day or because something good has happened. We celebrate birthdays, weddings, and new jobs.

examples.en: We celebrated my birthday at a small restaurant.
examples.tr: Doğum günümü küçük bir restoranda kutladık.

examples.en: How do you celebrate New Year in your country?
examples.tr: Ülkende yılbaşını nasıl kutlarsın?

examples.en: Let's celebrate! I got the job!
examples.tr: Kutlayalım! İşi aldım!

tr.note: Türkçe 'kutlamak' iki İngilizce fiile karşılık gelir: 'celebrate' (bir günü ya da olayı kutlamak) ve 'congratulate' (birini tebrik etmek).

mistakes.wrong: I celebrated her for the new job.
mistakes.right: I congratulated her on the new job.
mistakes.why: Kişiyi tebrik etmek için 'congratulate' kullanılır; 'celebrate' bir günü ya da olayı kutlamaktır.

quiz.cloze: We ______ our wedding anniversary every year with a nice dinner.

def.short: a special time when people enjoy music, food, films, or other events
def.long: A special event or time, often lasting several days, when people enjoy music, food, films, or other activities together. Many towns have a yearly festival.

examples.en: We went to a music festival last summer.
examples.tr: Geçen yaz bir müzik festivaline gittik.

examples.en: The film festival starts on Friday.
examples.tr: Film festivali cuma günü başlıyor.

examples.en: Our town has a food festival every autumn.
examples.tr: Kasabamızda her sonbahar bir yemek festivali olur.

tr.note: Türkçedeki 'festival' ile aynı anlamda; müzik, film, yemek gibi etkinlikler için kullanılır. 'Şenlik' daha çok halk eğlencesi, açık hava kutlaması demektir.

quiz.cloze: Thousands of people go to the music ______ every summer.

def.short: the event where two people get married, often with a big party
def.long: The event where two people get married, usually with a ceremony and a party for family and friends. Many people wear special clothes to a wedding.

examples.en: We are going to a wedding on Saturday.
examples.tr: Cumartesi bir düğüne gidiyoruz.

examples.en: Her wedding dress was white and very simple.
examples.tr: Gelinliği beyaz ve çok sadeydi.

examples.en: Everyone danced at the wedding until midnight.
examples.tr: Düğünde herkes gece yarısına kadar dans etti.

tr.note: 'Wedding' = düğün (tören ve parti); 'marriage' = evlilik (durum). 'Get married' = evlenmek. Nişan için 'engagement' denir.

mistakes.wrong: I will make a wedding next year.
mistakes.right: I will have a wedding next year. / I will get married next year.
mistakes.why: 'Düğün yapmak' için 'have a wedding' ya da 'get married' denir; 'make a wedding' denmez.

quiz.cloze: The bride and groom danced at their ______.

def.short: a person who comes to your home or event because you asked them
def.long: A person who comes to your home, party, or event because you asked them to come. A good host looks after the guests.

examples.en: We have two guests for dinner tonight.
examples.tr: Bu akşam yemeğe iki misafirimiz var.

examples.en: Welcome! You are our first guest.
examples.tr: Hoş geldiniz! İlk misafirimiz sizsiniz.

examples.en: All the wedding guests received a small gift.
examples.tr: Bütün düğün misafirleri küçük bir hediye aldı.

tr.note: 'Guest' davet edilen kişidir. Davetsiz gelen ziyaretçi, turist için 'visitor' kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: The first ______ arrived at the party at six.

def.short: something you give someone for free, for example on their birthday
def.long: Something you give to someone without asking for money, for example on a birthday or to say thank you. In everyday speech, 'present' is also very common.

examples.en: I bought a small gift for my teacher.
examples.tr: Öğretmenim için küçük bir hediye aldım.

examples.en: Thank you for the lovely gift!
examples.tr: Güzel hediyen için teşekkürler!

examples.en: The shop wraps gifts for free.
examples.tr: Dükkân hediyeleri ücretsiz paketliyor.

tr.note: Günlük konuşmada 'present' daha yaygındır; 'gift' mağaza ve kartlarda sık görülür (gift card = hediye çeki, gift shop = hediyelik eşya dükkânı).

quiz.cloze: I need to buy a birthday ______ for my mother.

def.short: a way of doing something that people have kept for many years
def.long: A belief or a way of doing things that older people have passed to younger people over many years. Many families have special traditions at holidays.

grammar.pattern: a tradition of / a family tradition

examples.en: Cooking this soup is an old tradition in our family.
examples.tr: Bu çorbayı pişirmek ailemizde eski bir gelenektir.

examples.en: Every country has its own food traditions.
examples.tr: Her ülkenin kendi yemek gelenekleri vardır.

examples.en: It's a family tradition to eat together on Sundays.
examples.tr: Pazar günleri birlikte yemek yemek aile geleneğimizdir.

tr.note: 'Tradition' = nesilden nesile geçen alışkanlık ya da uygulama. 'Traditional' = geleneksel (traditional food = geleneksel yemek).

mistakes.wrong: In my country, this is a tradition food.
mistakes.right: In my country, this is traditional food.
mistakes.why: İsimden önce sıfat gerekir: 'traditional food'. 'Tradition' isimdir, sıfat gibi kullanılmaz.

quiz.cloze: Making tea for guests is an old ______ in many homes.

def.short: a usual way of behaving in a group or place, often from long ago
def.long: A usual way of behaving or doing things in a particular country, place, or group of people. Customs can be different from country to country.

grammar.pattern: it is the custom to + verb

examples.en: It's a local custom to take off your shoes at home.
examples.tr: Evde ayakkabı çıkarmak yerel bir âdettir.

examples.en: Giving flowers is a common custom at weddings.
examples.tr: Düğünlerde çiçek vermek yaygın bir âdettir.

examples.en: Every country has different customs.
examples.tr: Her ülkenin âdetleri farklıdır.

tr.note: Tekil 'custom' = âdet, görenek. 'Customs' ise hem 'âdetler' hem 'gümrük' demektir: 'go through customs' = gümrükten geçmek.

mistakes.wrong: At the airport, we passed the custom.
mistakes.right: At the airport, we went through customs.
mistakes.why: 'Gümrük' için hep çoğul 'customs' kullanılır; 'custom' tekil hâli âdet demektir.

quiz.cloze: In many countries, it's the ______ to take off your shoes at home.

def.short: tell someone you are happy about their good news or success
def.long: To tell someone that you are happy about their good news or success, for example a new baby, a new job, or a good result. You congratulate a person ON something.

examples.en: I called to congratulate Ali on his new job.
examples.tr: Ali'yi yeni işi için tebrik etmek üzere aradım.

examples.en: Everyone congratulated her after the exam.
examples.tr: Sınavdan sonra herkes onu tebrik etti.

examples.en: Let me congratulate you on your wedding!
examples.tr: Düğününüz için sizi tebrik ederim!

tr.note: 'Tebrikler!' demek için hep çoğul 'Congratulations!' kullanılır. 'Celebrate' ise günü ya da olayı kutlamaktır; kişiyi tebrik etmek için 'congratulate' denir.

mistakes.wrong: I congratulated him for his new job.
mistakes.right: I congratulated him on his new job.
mistakes.why: 'Bir şey için tebrik etmek' → 'congratulate sb ON sth'; 'for' kullanılmaz.

quiz.cloze: Please ______ Elif on her new baby from all of us.

def.short: the person who invites guests and looks after them
def.long: The person who invites people to their home or to an event and looks after them. A good host makes sure everyone has food and feels welcome.

examples.en: Our host made us tea as soon as we arrived.
examples.tr: Ev sahibimiz gelir gelmez bize çay yaptı.

examples.en: Thank you, Ayşe. You are a wonderful host.
examples.tr: Teşekkürler Ayşe. Harika bir ev sahibisin.

examples.en: The host of the party introduced everyone to each other.
examples.tr: Partinin sahibi herkesi birbiriyle tanıştırdı.

tr.note: 'Host' misafir ağırlayan kişidir. Kiraya veren ev sahibi için 'landlord' kullanılır. Televizyonda sunucu da 'host' olarak adlandırılır.

mistakes.wrong: My host is raising the rent. (= kiraya veren)
mistakes.right: My landlord is raising the rent.
mistakes.why: Kiraya veren 'ev sahibi' = 'landlord'; 'host' misafir ağırlayan kişidir.

quiz.cloze: The ______ of the party made sure everyone had food.
